scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @workspace/url-utils run test && pnpm --filter @workspace/menu run test
scripts.check:static: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run check:hooks && pnpm run check:render-safety
scripts.verify-deployment: pnpm run build && pnpm run check:hooks && pnpm run check:render-safety && pnpm run check:freshness && pnpm run check:css-bundle && pnpm run check:no-http-links && pnpm run check:qr-generation
